previous_route.relation: This addendum closes the old-reference-cut equality branch at the level of an implementable proof route. The prior route and all source/review artifacts remain unchanged.

conclusion.route: Retain the cut equality branch. Use each stored root chart's actual full-component germ to obtain continuity at this cut, then extend the corresponding own-reference-half normalized atom bound with ContinuousWithinAt.closure_le.
conclusion.cut_bound: For both s:Bool and every theta, 3/4 <= (K.chart z k_s (c_m,theta)).1/rho_m <= 5/4.
conclusion.moving_target_refinement: If (c_m,theta) lies in the actual moving target half s, let v=target/rho_m and u=opposite/rho_m. Then 3/4 <= v < 1 and 1 < u <= 5/4.
conclusion.positive_margin: The target physical chart's first coordinate is at least (3/4)*rho_m > 0. This is a normalized root-coordinate margin on the original rho_m scale, not a uniform physical distance in r.
conclusion.strictness: The open-half inequality is strict <1/4. At the cut the closure argument gives <=1/4. Consequently u<=5/4 there, not u<5/4.
conclusion.no_whole_domain_shortcut: Whole-component chart germs supply regularity at the cut but do not turn the CurrentJets unitStrip estimate into an estimate on the entire component. A one-sided closure step remains necessary with the actual CurrentJets definition.

six_step_implementation.goal: Interior reference-half estimate in the actual physical point.
six_step_implementation.proof: For arbitrary side s and p in U_s, take q=n07aCanonicalUnitInversePoint (n07aPhysicalIntervalData K) k_s p. n07aCanonicalUnitInversePoint_maps gives q∈unitStrip; n07aCanonicalUnitPoint_inverse gives physicalUnitPoint K k_s q=p. The whole negative-fields theorem, actual cutPair metadata, left=0 and right=rho_m reduce the .chartRadial atom difference to |R_z,s(p)-R_ref,s(p)|<1/4.
six_step_implementation.caution: q at p_c itself has radial coordinate 0 or 1 and is outside unitStrip. Apply the atom bound before the closure step, only at p∈U_s.

six_step_implementation.goal: The actual reference value at the old cut is rho_m for both sides.
six_step_implementation.proof: n04bActualReferenceCut_mem hN m puts p_c in Omega_m. n04bReferenceTravelCut_spec gives opticalTravel D.w (C.left m) c_m=C.travel m/2. n04b_reference_actualTravelChart href hT hS hN hfield m hclosed theta gives reference travel=(T/2,theta). Take the value of the reference stored-chart component germ; each Bool orientation sends T/2 to T/2. n04b_rootCoordinate_middle T gives K.chart z_ref k_s p_c=(rho_m,theta), so R_ref,s(p_c)=1.
six_step_implementation.proof_arguments: href=hN.1.1.2.2.1; control=hN.1.1.2.2.2.1; radial profile=n04b_profileGeometry_of_through03 hN; reference hz/hs=n04b_reference_valid_of_through03 hN. Positive travel supplies rho_m>0.

six_step_implementation.goal: Actual stored current and reference chart continuity at p_c.
six_step_implementation.proof: For either state, let hg:=n04bActualTypedAtlas_negative_component_germs hT hS hN hfield e0 hz hs k_s m s hi hp_c and hr:=n04b_actualRootPhysical_regular_at hN hS hT hfield hz hs m s hp_c. Then hr.1.congr_of_eventuallyEq hg.1 is ContDiffAt of the actual stored chart. Take continuousAt, fst, divide by constant rho_m, subtract the reference function and apply abs.
six_step_implementation.domain: Only p_c∈Omega_m is used. No membership of p_c in the corresponding current half is needed.
six_step_implementation.caution: The closed_regular field of a negative-piece witness only concerns its own moving closed half. Do not use it for the opposite side at an arbitrary old cut. The hInteriorRegular name inside the existence proof is local, not a public supplier.

six_step_implementation.goal: p_c belongs to closure U_s for each Bool side.
six_step_implementation.proof: n04b_negativeHalf_bounds hC (n04bActualReferenceCut_mem hN) (m,s) supplies the strictly positive half width. U_s is exactly its radial open interval times univ by actual metadata. Rewrite closure_prod_eq, closure_Ioo hwidth.ne, closure_univ. At s=false the cut is the right endpoint; at s=true it is the left endpoint.
six_step_implementation.caution: closure_Ioo needs left≠right, hence hwidth.ne rather than hwidth.ne'. The continuity is needed only at p_c, not at the outer root of the closure.

six_step_implementation.goal: Closed cut deviation and both-sided [3/4,5/4] interval.
six_step_implementation.proof: Set f(p)=|R_z,s(p)-R_ref,s(p)| and g(p)=1/4. Apply ContinuousWithinAt.closure_le hpcClosure hf continuousWithinAt_const (fun p hp => (hInterior p hp).le). Steps2–3 provide the exact continuity and reference value; abs_le then gives 3/4≤R_z,s(p_c)≤5/4. Since s is arbitrary this holds for both halves, with the same globally chosen neighborhood.

six_step_implementation.goal: Moving target-half refinement and positive root-coordinate margin.
six_step_implementation.proof: If p_c is in actual moving side s, use hA=n04b_actualTypedAtlas_partA hT hS hN hfield e0. (hA.charts z hz hs k_s).1 hp gives 0<v<1 after metadata reduction and division by rho_m>0. The actual full-component opposite_normalized theorem gives u>0 and v^(3/2)+u^(3/2)=2. Real.rpow_lt_rpow hvpos.le hvltone (by norm_num) gives v^(3/2)<1; if u≤1, Real.rpow_le_rpow hupos.le huleone (by norm_num) contradicts that sum. Thus u>1. Step5 supplies u≤5/4 and v≥3/4.
six_step_implementation.result: 3/4≤v<1 and 1<u≤5/4. Hence (3/4)*rho_m≤(K.chart z k_s p_c).1, and this lower bound is strictly positive.
six_step_implementation.excluded_case: If p_c is itself the current artificial cut, it lies in neither moving open half. The unconditional two-sided cut estimate remains valid; the moving-half refinement is not invoked.

full_public_lexical_headers.name: n04Coordinates_currentAtoms_uniformly_close
full_public_lexical_headers.header:
theorem n04Coordinates_currentAtoms_uniformly_close
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {K : CanonicalData S}
    {base : ℕ} {ε δ : ℝ}
    (hD : IsAccumulatingProfile D) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hcur : CanonicalGeometry.CurrentJets D T S C L K base ε)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ base' : ℕ, base ≤ base' ∧ ∃ ε' : ℝ, 0 < ε' ∧ ε' ≤ ε ∧
      sectorNeighborhood S base' ε' ε' ⊆ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε ∧
      CanonicalGeometry.CurrentJets D T S C L K base' ε' ∧
      ∀ z ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base' ε' ε', ∀ m v p,
        p ∈ CanonicalGeometry.unitStrip →
          |CanonicalGeometry.atom D T S C L K (liftSectorParameter S C z) m v p -
            CanonicalGeometry.atom D T S C L K (C.referenceState, 0) m v p| < δ

full_public_lexical_headers.name: n04bActualTypedAtlas_negative_component_germs
full_public_lexical_headers.header:
theorem n04bActualTypedAtlas_negative_component_germs
    (k m : ℕ) (side : Bool) (hi : e k = .inl (m, side))
    {p : PolarPoint}
    (hp : p ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) :
    let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
    K.chart z k =ᶠ[𝓝 p]
        n04bRootPhysicalChart (n04bActualTravelChart S C L z m) (C.travel m) side ∧
      K.height z k =ᶠ[𝓝 p]
        n04bRootPhysicalHeight (L.coefficients z)
          (n04bCharacteristicHalfGap (L.coefficients z))
          (n04bActualTravelChart S C L z m) (C.travel m) side

full_public_lexical_headers.name: n04b_actualRootPhysical_regular_at
full_public_lexical_headers.header:
theorem n04b_actualRootPhysical_regular_at
    {p : PolarPoint} (hp : p ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (n04bRootPhysicalChart (n04bActualTravelChart S C L z m) (C.travel m) side) p ∧
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (n04bRootPhysicalHeight (L.coefficients z)
        (n04bCharacteristicHalfGap (L.coefficients z))
        (n04bActualTravelChart S C L z m) (C.travel m) side) p ∧
      planeJacobian
        (n04bRootPhysicalChart (n04bActualTravelChart S C L z m) (C.travel m) side) p ≠ 0 ∧
      0 < n04bRootPhysicalHeight (L.coefficients z)
        (n04bCharacteristicHalfGap (L.coefficients z))
        (n04bActualTravelChart S C L z m) (C.travel m) side p

full_public_lexical_headers.name: n04bActualTypedAtlas_negative_opposite_normalized
full_public_lexical_headers.header:
theorem n04bActualTypedAtlas_negative_opposite_normalized
    (k k' m : ℕ) (side : Bool)
    (hk : e k = .inl (m, side)) (hk' : e k' = .inl (m, !side))
    {p : PolarPoint} (hp : p ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) :
    let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
    let ρ := n04bRootCutRadius (C.travel m)
    let u := (K.chart z k' p).1 / ρ
    let v := (K.chart z k p).1 / ρ
    0 < u ∧ 0 < v ∧ v ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) + u ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) = 2 ∧
      v = (2 - u ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) ∧
      K.height z k p / K.height z k' p = (v / u) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ∧
      |planeJacobian (K.chart z k) p| / |planeJacobian (K.chart z k') p| =
        Real.sqrt (u / v)
